resources.string: Receipts from email
Search Gmail and choose the PDF or image to import. A draft opens so you can review the purchase.

This is optional and needs email read access separate from sign-in. We only request headers and attachments; we never send, delete or mark messages. Searches cover the past year. Selected attachments are processed on your phone and follow your account sync settings. Emails containing only a link cannot be imported here yet.
